description: This is a Python source file defining an abstract base class for testing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ingestion workflows. It includes abstract methods to be implemented for specific providers, and concrete test methods for ingesting documents and querying vector stores, facilitating unit testing of RAG integrations.

classes.name: BaseRAGTest
classes.description: Abstract base class for RAG ingestion tests, requiring subclasses to implement provider-specific ingest options and query methods, and providing built-in test methods for ingestion and querying workflows.

methods.name: RAGIngestOptions get_base_ingest_options(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve provider-specific ingest options.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] query_vector_store( self, vector_store_id: str, query: str, )
methods.description: Abstract asynchronous method to query the vector store and verify document ingestion.

methods.name: str get_unique_filename(self, prefix: str = "test")
methods.description: Generates a unique filename with a given prefix for test documents.

methods.name: test_basic_ingest(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous test method for ingesting a sample document into the vector store and checking the response.

methods.name: test_ingest_and_query(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that ingests a document, then queries the vector store repeatedly until the document is retrievable, verifying the end-to-end RAG flow.
